purpose: Read-only Phase B0 baseline for portable artifact routing. It captures host facts and known failure modes without installing, trusting, or enabling hooks.

codex_installation.reason: the current Claude-only case is evidence for topology and failure modes, not a portable dual-host implementation

claude.deny: exit code 2 with stderr blocks PreToolUse

codex.matcher: apply_patch; Edit|Write alias; Bash; MCP and other local function tool names
codex.input: JSON stdin; Bash and apply_patch use tool_input.command
codex.trust: /hooks review and hash trust required for new or changed non-managed definitions
codex.plugin_hook_support: supported but rejected as canonical installer because a project-owned configuration must remain after plugin removal

reuse_scan.reason: existing canonical ownership contract needs host capability and bypass baseline
existing project setup/update and managed-block contracts are the portable bundle input
existing deterministic setup fixture runner can validate the baseline without external project writes
existing instruction and routing handoff contract remains the initial-project input
read-only topology and failure-mode specimen only; do not copy its case-specific implementation
no canonical adapter or trust workflow exists in this repository; defer to Phase B1/B4

failure_fixtures.reason: approval marker must bind exactly one normalized target path and be consumed once
path containment must reject a sibling such as project-evil when project is the root
application ownership must come from discovered topology, not a case-specific BE/FE regex

bypass_boundaries: hosted tools and remote services outside the local hook path
shell-internal dynamic paths after command acceptance
external processes and writes outside the project root
